crossRefs.note: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me. My justice was as a robe and a diadem.
He has stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.
You shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that you have seen. You shall hurry and bring my father…
But you, Yahweh, are a shield around me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.
But his bow remained strong. The arms of his hands were made strong, by the hands of the Mighty One of Jacob, (from…
who satisfies your desire with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.
but those who wait for Yahweh will renew their strength. They will mount up with wings like eagles. They will run, and…
Therefore we don’t faint, but though our outward man is decaying, yet our inward man is renewed day by day.

translations.web: My glory is fresh in me. My bow is renewed in my hand.’
translations.bsb: My glory is ever new within me, and my bow is renewed in my hand.’
translations.kjv: My glory was fresh in me, and my bow was renewed in my hand.
translations.asv: My glory is fresh in me, And my bow is renewed in my hand.
